title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Lounge Access Network and Participating Airports
summary: This document explains lounge access for the Business Gold Rewards Card, covering access to 3 lounge networks and 9 complimentary visits per account year across participating lounges. It also provides how to locate lounges via the account lounge locator and what to present at entry (card, same-day boarding pass, and any requested ID), including varying hours/capacity/guest policies.
